edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price for the Shares by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by the Seller. edits.name: Purchase Price

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within five business days after each party has received written confirmation that all conditions to Closing have been satisfied or expressly waived in writing by the party entitled to the benefit of the applicable condition, or at such other time as the parties may agree in writing. The conditions to Closing are: (a) the representations and warranties of each party are true and correct in all material respects as of Closing; (b) each party has performed in all material respects its covenants required to be performed on or before Closing; (c) all governmental approvals and third-party consents required to consummate the transactions have been obtained and remain in effect; (d) no law or order of a governmental authority prohibits the transactions; and (e) each party has received the other party’s customary executed closing deliveries.
